motivation: Phase-2 review (M-4, K_w_ctrl) demanded a boundedness classification of every HDP state variable and every manuscript-facing HDP claim. The user direction: do NOT infer instability merely from K_w_ctrl=0.0; classify each claim into one of four classes (analytically bounded / bounded by implementation / numerically bounded over tested domain / not established); prospective domain definition plus a minimal run only; a scoped statement 'trajectories remained bounded over the tested parameter and time domain' is acceptable.
method: classification from the live kernel equations and clip/invariant structure, plus one minimal prospective run over a predeclared domain; no parameter tuning, no inference of instability.

boundedness_classes.analytically_bounded: a mathematical bound holds for the continuous-time/idealized law without reliance on the implementation's clamping
boundedness_classes.bounded_by_implementation: the discrete update clamps the variable at every step for all inputs (jnp.clip/invariants in jaxfne/emitters.py); no property of the ODE is needed
boundedness_classes.numerically_bounded_over_tested_domain: finite and well-behaved over the specific parameter and time domain covered by recorded runs
boundedness_classes.not_established: no claim of boundedness is supported at the stated level; absence of proof, not a claimed instability

kernel_facts.H: H_next = clip(H + dt/tau_i * dH, H_min=0.1, H_max=10.0); H_final additionally clipped after spike drain
kernel_facts.w: wmag_next = clip(wmag + dt*dw, w_floor, w_ceiling) then sign restored via exc_mask; w_floor=0.01, w_ceiling=10.0 in BASE_HDP_KWARGS_DEFAULT (kernel default ceiling 50.0)
kernel_facts.v_u_syn: _bound_state applies v in [-150, 100], |u| <= 2000, |syn| <= 1e4 at every step; spikes binary
kernel_facts.dw_structure: dw = +-K_HDP * rule_basis * wmag + K_w_ctrl * (wmag_baseline - wmag); rule_basis in {H_post-H_pre, (H_post-H_pre)|..|, H_pre*H_post} - bounded because H is clamped
kernel_facts.dH_structure: dH = alpha*syn + beta - gamma*H*spikes - delta*W_burden + rho_passive/H^2 + K_ctrl*(1-H) + barrier_force; barrier denominators floored at barrier_eps=1e-3; syn bounded by decay recursion syn_next = decay*syn + spikes[pre]

C-HDP-1.claim: H_i is bounded (docs/doctrine/protocol_w_hdp_parameter_memory.md 'Q: ... bounded, physically sane dynamics?', stability doctrine)

classification.detail: jnp.clip to [0.1, 10.0] every step, unconditional; additionally for K_ctrl > 0 the ODE has a two-sided restoring term (analytically bounded within the band); for K_ctrl = 0 and gamma = delta = 0 the drift is one-sided and only the clamp bounds it (consistently with the rho_sweep observation H pinned near H_max)

C-HDP-1.allowed_language: H is hard-clamped to [H_min, H_max] = [0.1, 10.0] at every integration step regardless of parameters or inputs

classification.detail: every-step clip to [w_floor, w_ceiling]; with K_w_ctrl > 0 the continuous-time law additionally contracts toward wmag_baseline (analytically bounded given clamped H)

C-HDP-2.allowed_language: |w| is hard-clamped to [w_floor, w_ceiling] at every integration step; with K_w_ctrl > 0 an additional restoring term pulls |w| toward its calibrated baseline

C-HDP-3.claim: DEFAULT_HDP with K_w_ctrl = 0.0 is safe with no weight-magnitude restoration

classification.detail: per user direction, K_w_ctrl = 0.0 implies nothing about instability; the shipped-preset trials remain the verified domain (see C-HDP-5). Long-horizon drift behavior with K_w_ctrl = 0.0 is not established

C-HDP-3.allowed_language: with the default K_w_ctrl = 0.0 the weight magnitude has no active restoration; boundedness across arbitrary long horizons was not established and is guaranteed only per-step by the [w_floor, w_ceiling] clamp

C-HDP-4.claim: reciprocal/restricting force: 'Exponential admissibility plus linear omega-restoration address positivity and zero-drive drift' (protocol_w_hdp_parameter_memory.md W1)

classification.detail: architecture-level claim about the W0 exponential-parameterization (W = W0 * exp(omega)) with linear omega-restoration, distinct from the emitter clip-path; per w0_mathematical_contract.json
classification.scope_in: W0 exponential-omega architecture only; does not describe the emitter's clip-path w update

C-HDP-4.allowed_language: in the W0 exponential-omega parameterization the restored omega stays bounded, keeping W = W0 exp(omega) in a bounded tube

C-HDP-5.claim: DEFAULT_HDP verified dynamics on its trial lengths ('Verified 5-seed stable (N=500, 2000ms)' etc., hdp_network.py notes; k_w_ctrl_sweep receipt)

classification.detail: 20s/5-seed gate note: H=1.0020+-0.0000, rate~10.8Hz, all seeds pass (K_ctrl active); k_w_ctrl sweep: all_finite, growth_ratio_mean 1.0265 (K_w_ctrl=0) / 1.0130 (1e-4) / 0.9980 (1e-3) over its window

C-HDP-5.allowed_language: trajectories remained bounded over the tested parameter and time domain (see receipts); statements are scoped to those runs

C-HDP-6.claim: W3a active-loop instability bracket I_tonic in [8, 10] (artifacts/protocol_w/w3a_stability/w3a_stability_receipt.json)

classification.detail: analysis-level (FROZEN_ANALYSIS), W3 kernel not authorized; margin audit (w3a_margin_audit.json) documented monodromy-period false positives; corrected regime rule in W3b. The bracket is a linearized-analysis finding with known methodology caveats, not a claim about the discrete kernel's per-step clamps

C-HDP-6.allowed_language: a linearized closed-loop analysis of the W0/HDP slow dynamics flagged a stability margin crossing between I_tonic ~ 8 and 10 under nominal parameters; this analysis is not the discrete-time kernel, and the margin methodology has a documented audit caveat

classification.detail: receipt status FROZEN_UNRESOLVED; the 2187-point characterization does not resolve which domain simultaneously permits active, bounded, nontrivial, robust HDP

C-HDP-7.allowed_language: the parameter-domain map is unresolved; no active closed-loop stability claim rests on it

C-HDP-8.claim: v, u, syn state finiteness in the HDP kernel

classification.detail: _bound_state clips all three every step; v additionally has the analytic reset structure (spike >= 30mV -> reset to c)

C-HDP-8.allowed_language: v, u, syn are hard-bounded every step (v in [-150, 100] mV, |u| <= 2000, |syn| <= 1e4), so HDP runs cannot overflow or underflow in float32

prospective_run.domain: predeclared, minimal: both shipped presets x 3 seeds on the frozen C3 ring construction

substrate.drive: identical to C3: n0 pulse amplitude 50 at 200-201 ms, n6 pulse amplitude 45 at 800-801 ms
